metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer apparel accessories for your team. Perfect for uniforms and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration gives you full-color, photo-quality logos on apparel accessories like hats, scarves, and gloves. Unlike embroidery, it handles fine details and gradients without thread limits. This method works best for polyester or poly-blend fabrics, making it a smart choice for modern performance materials. Bulk orders benefit from consistent, vibrant prints that won't crack or peel when applied correctly.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer apparel accessories featuring full-color logo on a black performance cap and scarf set.
